title: After the Osaka Hai: Hands to the Sky

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin enjoys the Osaka Hai to her heart's content, unburdened by all that she had tried to carry alone as the older sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No longer shackled by the feeling that she's being selfish by running, she crosses the finish line with a glowing smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following the race, she feels an even stronger resolve to live up to the dreams of the people supporting her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Ines tells me she's eyeing the Takarazuka Kinen, a race which fields the most popular runners, I give her my full support without hesitation.
